description: LihFolk V2 post-edit Luau checks for changed Roblox files. Licensed CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Codex requires the user to review and trust this hook before it runs.

hooks.command: python3 -c 'import runpy,pathlib; cwd=pathlib.Path.cwd(); root=next((p for p in (cwd,*cwd.parents) if (p/".codex"/"lihfolk"/"codex_post_tool.py").is_file()),cwd); runpy.run_path(str(root/".codex"/"lihfolk"/"codex_post_tool.py"),run_name="__main__")'
hooks.commandWindows: py -3 -c "import runpy,pathlib; cwd=pathlib.Path.cwd(); root=next((p for p in (cwd,*cwd.parents) if (p/'.codex'/'lihfolk'/'codex_post_tool.py').is_file()),cwd); runpy.run_path(str(root/'.codex'/'lihfolk'/'codex_post_tool.py'),run_name='__main__')"
